security_audit.summary: All 50 static findings are false positives. The apparent command findings are Markdown backticks or documentation text, while the archive code performs local skill packaging. remediation.issue: The packager accepts a user-supplied source folder and output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should package only trusted local folders and inspect archive contents before sharing.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misclassify Markdown backticks and example filenames as command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use scanner rules that distinguish fenced Markdown and prose from executable shell syntax.

content.value_statement: Building a skill can be difficult when scope, instructions, and reusable files are unclear. This guide provides a repeatable process for designing, validating, and packaging focused skills.
actual_capabilities: Guides skill scope, trigger descriptions, and core instructions.
Explains when to include scripts, references, and output assets.
Provides a script to initialize a skill directory structure.
Provides a validator for SKILL.md frontmatter and naming rules.
Packages a validated skill folder into a local .skill archive.
Offers workflow and output-pattern references for skill design.
limitations: It does not test whether a skill produces correct results in every AI tool.
The validator checks basic frontmatter rules, not instruction quality or security.
The packager archives local files and does not publish a skill.
Users must review bundled scripts and references before distribution.

use_cases.title: Start a new internal skill
use_cases.description: Create a focused directory and draft clear instructions for a repeatable team workflow.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing skill
use_cases.description: Review scope, move detailed material into references, and remove unnecessary files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a distributable package
use_cases.description: Validate frontmatter and create a local .skill archive for manual review or sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Define a simple skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a skill for [task]. Ask for the users, inputs, outputs, and limits. Then propose a focused SKILL.md outline.

prompt_templates.title: Choose resources
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a [domain] skill. Identify which information belongs in SKILL.md, references, scripts, and assets. Explain each choice.

prompt_templates.title: Review instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill design for unclear triggers, duplicated guidance, missing constraints, and unnecessary context. Suggest specific improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release checklist for my skill. Include frontmatter validation, resource review, test prompts, and local package inspection.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for weekly incident summaries.
output: A focused skill scope for incident summaries.
A suggested instruction outline and reference file list.
Questions to confirm audience, data sources, and approval steps.

output_examples.input: Review my database query assistant skill.
output: Clearer trigger wording for database-related requests.
Recommendations for separating schema references from core instructions.

best_practices: Define one clear job and state when the skill should activate.
Keep core instructions concise and place detailed material in references.
Validate and inspect every bundled file before sharing a package.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated workflows in one skill.
Do not duplicate the same guidance in SKILL.md and reference files.
Do not package unreviewed scripts or sensitive local files.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps you design, organize, validate, and package AI skills.

faq.question: Which tools can use this guidance?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does the validator check every security concern?
faq.answer: No. It checks basic SKILL.md frontmatter and naming requirements.

faq.question: What does the packaging script produce?
faq.answer: It creates a local .skill archive from a validated skill folder.

faq.question: Should I include scripts in every skill?
faq.answer: No. Include scripts only when repeatable operations need executable automation.

faq.question: Can this skill publish my package?
faq.answer: No. It only creates a local archive. You choose how to review and distribute it.
